text:
maria: CI red on `serve/session_test` in master after the scheduler shuffle PR. failing in 3/20 runs locally for me, looks timing-y. anyone oncall who can kick a rerun?

tiм: @maria I can take a look in a bit. do we have the failing log snippet?

maria: paste from CI:
```
--- FAIL: TestSessionRetryOrdering (0.12s)
    session_test.go:214: expected call order [start recv ack] got [start ack recv]
```

maria: behavior seems nondeterministic, repro rate ~15% locally with `go test ./... -run TestSessionRetryOrdering -count 20`

ci-bot: Rerun requested by tim — queued job #48213

jen: tagging @sam since this smells like the recent retry jitter change in scheduler.go

sam: looking. quick question: are you running with `-race`? that can change timing.

maria: not for the 20-count runs. tried with and without race; both show flakes but different distributions.

sam: ok. can you run with the env var `DEBUG_SCHED_SEED=1` to pin the RNG and see if failure is reproducible for a specific seed? I suspect the shuffle seed interacts with goroutine scheduling.

maria: running a sweep now: `for s in {1..50}; do DEBUG_SCHED_SEED=$s go test -run TestSessionRetryOrdering -count 1 || echo "seed=$s failed"; done` — will paste results

maria: results so far: seed=7 failed, seed=19 failed, seed=34 failed. 3 seeds out of 50.

sam: interesting. can you capture the logs for seed=7? also add `--benchtime` ? (actually nevermind for unit test)

maria: log for seed=7:
```
2026-03-17T15:02:10Z serve: session start
2026-03-17T15:02:10Z serve: sent request -> worker A
2026-03-17T15:02:10Z serve: worker A ack
2026-03-17T15:02:10Z serve: received response (delayed)
2026-03-17T15:02:10Z serve: retry issued before response processed
```

tim: that ordering matches the failure. retry happens after ack but before the delayed response is processed -> duplicate in-flight state.

sam: probable root cause: our retry backoff jitter now allows very short backoffs that race with slow response processing path. fix options:
- increase min backoff in tests
- make test wait for inflight handler to complete before asserting
- make scheduler produce deterministic ordering for unit tests (seeded but deterministic thread scheduling is hard)

jen: prefer trying to harden the test to assert on final state rather than exact ordering. ordering isn't guaranteed in production either.

maria: agree. but we should also add a check that the retry path doesn't double-apply effects (idempotency). I'll open a small PR to make assertions idempotent + add seed sweep into flaky test harness.

sam: also add a note in the comment that `DEBUG_SCHED_SEED` can be used to reproduce; include the failing seeds.

maria: PR draft: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/serve/pull/2345 — title "test(session): make retry ordering idempotent + seed sweep info"

tim: nice. CI rerun completed, job #48213 passed this time.

ci-bot: Job #48213: succeeded (re-run) — all green

jen: let's also add a tiny integration test that simulates slow response to catch regression, but keep it in a separate flaky-tolerant suite.

sam: sg. I'll review the PR and add a small change to ensure min backoff floored at 5ms in test mode.

maria: thanks everyone. follow-up: I'll add the seed-to-repro mapping to the test output when it fails so CI logs include the seed.

tim: thanks — ping here when PR is ready for review :thumbsup:

maria: will do :slightly_smiling_face:
